text: This report recommends that the name "Railway Lane" be approved to identify a public lane extending between Nickle Street and Victoria Boulevard, as well as that portion of Victoria Boulevard extending northerly from Ray Avenue to its intersection with the lane. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Railway Lane" for a public lane extending between Nickle Street and Victoria Boulevard. 2. Approved the name "Railway Lane" for the renaming of the portion of Victoria Boulevard extending northerly from Ray Avenue to its intersection with the public lane. __________ Etobicoke York Community Council held a public meeting on April 4, 2018, and notice was given in accordance with the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Notice of the proposed enactment of the draft by-law was posted on the Public Notice Page of the City's website.
